original_value: Northpeak Aurora Loom is a fictional 27-inch ultrawide monitor built for creative workspaces and general productivity. It features a 3440x1440 IPS panel, 100Hz refresh rate, slim bezels, USB-C input, and an adjustable stand designed for desktop setups that need extra horizontal space for timelines, spreadsheets, and split-screen multitasking.
